# Synthetic native desktop acceptance evidence

Captured through the installed macOS Wails UI on September 19, 2026. See
[the candidate identities and reproduction steps](../../../docs/native-acceptance.md).
No customer data, customer targets, credentials or hardware identifiers occur.
All names and appointment values were generated by Readmit's frozen synthetic
sample. This directory is test evidence, never approved for a real target.

`native-test.json` is the file authored through the UI. `regression/` is its
original generated case. `baseline/` and `post-fix/` are complete, byte-identical
copies of the native run result directories, relocated for independent reading.
The captured spec/target/session references inside them remain exactly as recorded;
readers verify retained evidence without connecting to those old loopback ports.
The original workspace's outer receiver folders and unused sample variants are
not copied because each result retains the complete evidence it needs.

The unchanged source case identity is
`7d266d0a09e92d3322d6346cf16c9dd37c768c02a11f8ea6c41870adc44915df`.
Baseline result identity is
`1fc7f1c35da20d3ed765ce8327be6bc2e837dc11033ce5a1e4657ba0904804d8`;
post-fix result identity is
`e682336bd58d47bbde766203164659ea0f6032c982846d5cecb12fbb6266ce42`.
The ordinary identity files preserve the original contract commitments.

From the repository root:

```sh
make test-focused PKGS='./tests' ARGS='-run TestRetainedNativeDesktopJourneyIsIndependentlyReadable'
readmit diff testdata/acceptance/native-109/baseline testdata/acceptance/native-109/post-fix --format json
```

The reader re-evaluates one `ledger_count` expectation of one: baseline observed
two and failed; post-fix observed one and passed. The diff requires two unchanged
sent messages, zero changed fields, and distinct retained result verdicts.
The regression also deletes the final observation from a temporary copy and
requires the executable to refuse it. Nothing rewrites these retained originals.
